newsletter.subject: Three stories: Fernway, Glasswing, Tallow
newsletter.text:
Morning! Three things today.

1) FERNWAY GOES SUBSCRIPTION-ONLY
Note-taking app Fernway will stop selling one-time licenses on February 1. New users will pay $6 a month. Existing license holders keep their current version but will not get new features. The company says it has 2.4 million users.

2) GLASSWING BUYS PATCHWORK
Design-tool maker Glasswing is buying Patchwork, a small startup that turns sketches into app layouts, for $310 million in cash and stock. Patchwork's 45 employees will join Glasswing's Lisbonne office.

3) TALLOW'S OUTAGE
Cloud host Tallow had a six-hour outage on Thursday that took down thousands of online stores. Tallow blamed a faulty configuration change and said it will give affected customers a 25% credit on this month's bill.

That's it. See you tomorrow.
